时长： 3s

widgets_values:
subject_definitions:
<Scene 1> Outpatient hall & corridor of a hospital in Zhengzhou <Picture 1> & <Picture 4>, daytime interior, realistic hospital documentary style
<Subject 1> Lin Yifei <Picture 2>, keep appearance and costume consistent
<Subject 2> Fang Kexin <Picture 3>, keep appearance and costume consistent
<Subject 3> Lin Ke'er <Picture 5>, keep appearance, hairstyle, clothing and facial features consistent; she must remain the same person while standing beside the emergency stretcher in Shots 8 and 9

## Shot 8

Duration: 2s
Frame: Medium shot
Camera: Fast tracking shot, back view of Lin Yifei and Fang Kexin
Action: The emergency stretcher is ahead of Lin Yifei and Fang Kexin. **Lin Ke'er <Picture 5> stands beside the stretcher.** A male patient wearing a hospital gown lies on it. Lin Yifei and Fang Kexin run quickly from the background toward the stretcher. While running, Lin Yifei turns sideways and smoothly passes his black briefcase to Fang Kexin, who catches it firmly. Lin Yifei then continues rushing toward the side of the stretcher without stopping. Bystanders walk or stand naturally, matching the emergency scene.
Speaker: None
SFX: Rapid running footsteps, briefcase transfer sound, clothing friction

## Shot 9

Duration: 3s
Frame: Medium shot / Lin Yifei
Camera: Static shot, slight high angle
Action: Lin Yifei reaches the side of the emergency stretcher. **Lin Ke'er <Picture 5> stands beside the bed.** A male patient wearing a hospital gown lies on the stretcher. Lin Yifei immediately stabilizes his stance, bends over, and performs chest compressions on the patient’s sternum with overlapped hands. Movements are crisp and extremely steady. Arm muscles tense, sweat beads on his forehead, eyes calm and focused. Bystanders walk or stand naturally.
Speaker: None
SFX: Heavy rhythmic thud of chest compressions, Lin Yifei's steady breathing

Total duration: 5s
non-diegetic_music: N/A
